verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a framework with published documentation, so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question. The evidence shows no such offering: probes for llms.txt and markdown versions of the docs both returned HTTP 404. The llms.txt probe targeted the microsoft.github.io root rather than the AutoGen docs path, which lowers confidence somewhat.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
